environment.description: Qualified Studio/Demo candidate; focused synthetic contracts, real MapLibre pixels, normal-owner revision-checked save/fresh read, exact-source local PNG/JPEG/PDF and independent Google Earth Pro7.3.7.1327 rendered Save Image preview/control comparison. Source publication and revised delivery pending.
limitations: Map frames and figure PDF are raster captures; PDF embeds the composed JPEG and is not selectable/georeferenced.3D compass, measured scale and grid are visibly omitted. MapLibre is the accepted capture engine; other engines remain unverified.

Output DPI rerenders loaded vectors but adds no finer upstream raster/terrain data. Letterboxing preserves the captured viewport. System-font metrics may differ; supplied raster formats retain fixed pixels. Arbitrary authored Styles, scripts/fonts/devices and full WCAG/tagged-PDF conformance are not claimed.

Actual owner historical-scene proof uses blank basemap and disabled date metadata; active date/imagery attribution has controlled-source functional evidence, not new provider reconstruction/freshness proof.

Independent Google Earth Pro7.3.7.1327 comparison uses actual rendered scene/Save Image previews and controls. Final native file-modal dispatch was uncertain; no native exported file or custom-annotation configuration/equivalence is claimed. Native service usage is uninstrumented.
Source publication and revised frontend deployment/readback remain pending; local candidate acceptance is not production delivery or whole-product Google Earth parity.
